capabilities: Rewrite exact plain-text paths, including the .md extension, after a move or rename
Batch-scan all Markdown notes after a 2-second pause following a folder move
Collect unchanged mentions with their file and line number
Append a log entry to a chosen Markdown note after each move
Restrict rewriting to notes inside selected folders
disambiguation: Not a general link fixer; it never touches wikilinks or Markdown links and only rewrites plain-text paths.
extras: Warns that moves made outside Obsidian (file manager, git, scripts) do not fire the rename event and cannot be detected. README includes a Korean-language summary. Requires Obsidian's 'Automatically update internal links' setting to be on for wikilink handling.
intentEvidence: Obsidian updates wikilinks and Markdown links when you move a note, but it leaves plain-text paths alone.
problem: Obsidian only rewrites wikilinks and Markdown links when notes move, so plain-text paths in frontmatter values or inline code break silently.
summary: Path rewriter that updates plain-text file paths in notes after you move or rename files, covering paths Obsidian's link updater leaves unchanged.
